sources.literal_prompt_evidence: A broad blood-pressure cuff wraps snugly around that bare upper arm, its lower edge above the elbow. One continuous rubber hose runs from the cuff's connector across the tabletop into the socket of a digital blood-pressure monitor, with both joins and the whole intervening hose visible.
A seated clinician and a seated patient face each other across the open end of a desk; an examination couch stands against the adjacent wall.

gates.requirement: The wide cuff wraps this patient upper arm and a continuous tube leaves the cuff to a separate monitor on the table, with complete endpoints together.
Clinician and patient are both seated, faces toward one another across the open end of a desk, and a separate examination couch stands against the adjacent wall.
